ataque.inicio.bando: ⚔ {lider} and company come out of the woods and attack {vila}! The guard runs to the square.
ataque.vitoria: ✦ {vila} breathes again. The townsfolk step out of their houses to thank you.
ataque.dispersa: The pack scatters into the woods around {vila}.

guarda.grito: Close the line, close the line!
bark.manha: The rooster crowed twice. Either rain or death.
Hot bread in the square, first come first served.
Sleep well, {nome}? I didn't. The dogs howled all night.
A morning this cold calls for broth.
Is the gate open yet? The woodcutters want to leave early.
bark.dia: Sun's high. Good for drying leather, bad for whoever works the forge.
If you go into the woods, be back before dark.
The market is packed today. Anyone seen Thorin?
They say in Askavik even the alleys are paved with stone.
Who dropped a bucket in the well? Again?
bark.noite: Close the window, it's night already.
At night not even the dog goes out alone.
Did you hear that? No… must have been the wind.
Light the lamp, the dark here has an owner.
Come back early tomorrow, {nome}. The night charges whoever walks in it.
The owls are quiet. That's never good.
bark.frio: This cold gets into your bones and moves in.
Got firewood at home? I don't.
Snow before the week is out, I'd bet my cap.
Rub your hands, {nome}, or the sword will slip.
bark.calor: What heat. The beer gets warm before it reaches your mouth.
Even the flies are tired today.
In the shade of the temple you can breathe.
bark.lua: The moon is bleeding… Shut everything, for the Eye's sake.
Blood Moon night: the Count's spawn come out to hunt.
My grandfather used to say: when the moon turns red, the wolf remembers it was once a man.
Don't stare at it, {nome}. They say it stares back.
Tonight even the dead in the graveyard are restless.
bark.aurora: Dawn Day! Smell that? It's Auréon passing by.
The paladins have been singing since early. Makes you want to believe.
Today any kindness counts double. Make the most of it, {nome}.
See the sparkles falling? My daughter wants to keep one in a jar.
bark.combate: By the Eye, don't let it reach the houses!
Yes! One more like that and the village sleeps in peace.
bark.ferido: You're bleeding, {nome}. Sit down a moment.
The healer has ointment. Go before you drop.
With that face even I could beat you. Eat something!
Don't die on my doorstep, please.
bark.montado: Fine horse. Take care of it, good horses don't grow on trees.
Easy with that beast in the square, there are children!
How much did that mount cost? No, don't tell me. I'll cry.
bark.pet: What a lovely {pet}! Can I pet it?
That {pet} already stole bread off my table.
Take good care of {pet}, a loyal animal is worth more than gold.
bark.novato: You the new one? You look like you woke up yesterday.
First time in Karmika? Don't eat the blue mushrooms.
Take it easy, {nome}. Rats bite too.
bark.veterano: They say you've brought down something big, {nome}.
Look who's back. The village is safer with you here.
My son wants to be like you. I told him he has to eat his greens first.
bark.luz: The village speaks well of you, {nome}.
Good people still exist. May the Eye keep you, {nome}.
The children say you're a hero. Don't let it go to your head.
bark.sombra: …don't talk to me. I heard what you did.
Hide the purse, Marta, look who's coming.
Your eyes have changed, {nome}. The dogs can tell.
There's more in your shadow than there is in you.
bark.vam: He didn't eat a thing at the tavern. Again.
Garlic on the door, Marta. Now.
bark.lob: Smells like wet dog… is that you?
Did your eyes just glow? No, must have been the lantern.
The village dogs go quiet when you pass. Strange.
bark.mag: A mage in the village! Think he'll fix the well with magic?
Keep that staff away from my chickens.
bark.bru: Cross yourself, girl. It's the warlock.
They say a warlock pays the price with his own shadow.
I won't take your coin. What if it's cursed.
bark.pal: A paladin of Auréon! Will you bless my son?
With you here I sleep with the window open.
The armor shines even at night, look at that.
bark.cac: A hunter from the Bastion… who died?
If you're here, there's a demon nearby.
Silver on the belt. So what they say is true.
bark.tecno: What's that noise in your chest? A tin heart?
The Academy sent another one. Careful with that reactor near the hay.
My grandfather said machines have no soul. Do you?
bark.gue: A warrior of the North! Odin still sends his own.
Easy with that axe, the village is small.
Nice scars. How many enemies was that?
bark.rep_alta: Look who's here! Sit down, {nome}, make yourself at home.
My mother prays for you every night. Really.
If you need anything, just ask. Anything.
The children play at being you, did you know?
I saved the best piece of bread for you.
bark.rep_baixa: The guards have their eye on you.
Get out of here before I call someone.
No shopkeeper here will give you a fair price.
bark.despedida: So it's true? You're leaving Karmika?
The village will be quieter without you, {nome}.
Take a piece of cheese for the road. Take it!
I'll miss you. Don't tell anyone I said that.
Come back now and then, you hear? Promise.
Garrick pretends otherwise, but he's proud.
bark.festa: More beer here! The dwarf brought a barrel for the whole village!
This meat is divine, who roasted it?
Somebody stop Bento before he sings again.
Dance, {nome}! Tonight the party is yours!
bark.volta: You're back! The party is still the talk of the tavern.
Well look at that, the hero of Karmika home again!
Tell us, tell us: what's the world like out there?
Your seat at the table is still saved.
Lúcia will be happy to see you. Bento too.
bark.r_guarda: Stay inside the walls after sundown, {nome}.
Seen anyone strange on the road? Let me know.
I've guarded this gate since before you could walk.
bark.r_ferreiro: The forge doesn't wait. Cold iron doesn't forgive.
Bring ore and I'll work miracles.
That blade of yours needs an edge, you know?
bark.r_taverna: Stew of the day: whatever was there yesterday.
Karmika beer, best in the valley. The only one, but the best.
Sit down, {nome}, the corner table is free.
bark.r_mercador: Good price, today only. Tomorrow too.
I buy everything that shines and half of what doesn't.
Gold in one hand, goods in the other. Simple.
bark.r_fe: The Eye of Marghar sees what you do, {nome}. Everything.
Pray before you sleep. Those who don't pray, dream.
Every soul comes back. Mind what you carry.
fofoca.luz: Good people. Helped the miller's widow without asking for a thing.
They say {nome} never leaves anyone behind.
The Eye must like them. Luck walks alongside.
Yesterday {nome} paid for the whole table's beer.
And didn't even brag about it. That's rare.
…the guard would have to find other work.
My daughter wants to be like {nome}.
She could have a worse example.
fofoca.neutro: {nome}. Nobody really knows where they came from.
{nome} goes armed even to buy bread.
In times like these, so would I.
People like that never stay. The road calls.
They say {nome} has died once already.
Everyone has died once. Ask the Eye.
fofoca.sombra: Hide the purse. And the chickens.
Me too. And I believe half, which is plenty.
Because nobody wants to be the first to try.
fofoca.feito.bom: Heard it at the tavern. I bought a round in their honor.
I can. Saw it with my own eyes.
fofoca.feito.mau: May the Eye have mercy on them. I won't.
Lock your door tonight, all right?
grito.elite.human: What kind of monstrosity is that? I am going to outlive you!
I wasn't born a hero. But I wasn't born to run either.
Karmika will know I was here. Come on!
Big, ugly and slow. Two out of three I can fix with a sword.
My mother used to say: look fear in the eye. There. I looked.
The Eye is watching. So let's make it worth the show.
If I fall, I fall standing.
grito.elite.nordic: Odin! Send the ravens: there will be meat on the ground today!
By Thor's hammer, this thing is going to learn how to bleed!
Valhalla is waiting. But not today, beast!
Did Fenrir send you? Tell him I am right here!
One more name for my saga. Come on, you mountain of meat!
My shield has eaten worse than you for breakfast!
The North does not step back. Forward!
grito.elite.dwarf: By the beard of Grand Master Cascudo! What is that abomination? It looks like my mother-in-law!
By the Forge! I am going to hammer this beast into an anvil!
Uglier than a dwarf with no beard. And that, my friend, is ugly.
Come closer, big fella. My hatchet wants a word.
Rock does not run. And I am made of rock!
That thing smells like bad ore. I will smelt it the hard way.
Too big for my cave, just right for my axe!
grito.elite.elf: May the Ancients forgive me for taking a life. But this monster must depart.
The forest weeps when you pass. Today it will smile.
My people have waited a thousand years for this. I will not miss.
Return to the silence you came from.
My bow knows your heart better than you do.
Not every shadow deserves the night. Yours does not.
By the leaves of Aelvaren: not today.
grito.elite.tecno: Let's see if this reactor really works now! Die, you wretched thing!
Insufficient data. I will collect it in the field.
That is primitive biology. I am the future.
Overload authorized. May the Academy forgive my power bill.
You do not know what an ampere is. You are about to.
Easy, easy… adjusting the sights… now!
Science is not afraid. I am, a little. But science is in charge.
grito.elite.pal: May Auréon shield me in this battle. Forward!
The light does not bargain with the shadow. Neither do I.
Kneel, creature, and I may pray for you.
I was ordained for this. Come!
Every blow of mine is a prayer. Get ready to hear many.
In the name of those you devoured: enough.
Faith does not take the pain away. But it holds the shield.
grito.elite.cac: Hm… that head is going to look great above my fireplace!
One more name on the list. Crossed off shortly.
The School taught me to hunt things like you. Today is the final exam.
Run, if you like. I hunt better when the prey runs.
Demon, beast or abomination: they all die the same.
I have seen worse. That's a lie. I will kill you anyway.
The crossbow is ready. Is your head?
grito.elite.vam: What a waste of blood. I will put it to use.
Scream. The night is fond of music.
Centuries taught me patience. You will teach me nothing.
The Court will enjoy this story. You will not be in it.
I have already died once. Your turn.
So much flesh, so little spirit. Allow me to correct that.
Come into the shadow. I live here.
grito.elite.lob: The pack heard you from afar. Now it will feel you.
I can smell your fear. Delicious.
I am the beast you fear in the dark. Look at me.
The moon is not even up and I already want blood.
Big prey. Good. I was hungry.
Howl with me, monster. Then be silent forever.
Nobody hunts in my forest. Nobody.
grito.elite.mag: The Library has a chapter about you. A short one.
Fire, ice or lightning? I will let you choose… no, I will choose.
They say magic is dangerous. For you, it is.
May the Ancients guide my hand. And may it not tremble.
You are matter. I am will.
One well-cast spell is worth a thousand swords. I will cast two.
Knowledge beats strength. Always. Let us prove it.
grito.elite.bru: The pact wants your heart. I will deliver it.
Come, beast. The cauldron needs one big ingredient.
My marks burn when something like you comes near. How lovely.
I do not pray. I collect.
The shadow whispers your name. It says today is the day.
Pact, pact, be fulfilled: bring me this flesh.
You are ugly. I am worse. Let us see who bleeds.
grito.chefe.human: So it is you. I thought you would be bigger. I thought wrong. Whatever!
If the Eye wants a story, I will write one.
grito.chefe.nordic: This is the battle the bards will sing. Let them sing it loud!
My blood for the North. Yours for my blade!
grito.chefe.dwarf: By the Forge, by the Stone and by my father's beard: TODAY!
It is big. I have seen bigger mountains. And tunnelled through them.
Mother-in-law? No. This one is worse!
grito.chefe.elf: The Ancients whisper your end. I am the voice.
A thousand years of patience. Over.
May the forest remember this day.
grito.chefe.tecno: Reactor at one hundred percent. Let the experiment begin.
You are the variable. I am the result.
Academy, put it on record: today science killed a god.
grito.chefe.pal: AURÉON! See your servant and guide my blade!
The light does not go out. The shadow does. Now.
For the innocent. For the fallen. For all of them.
grito.chefe.cac: The hunt of a lifetime. At last.
The fireplace is going to need a bigger wall.
No tricks. No running. Just the two of us.
grito.chefe.vam: What a magnificent creature. I will drink it all.
Eternity brought me here. Be worthy of it.
Kneel. It is what mortals do before me.
grito.chefe.lob: THE MOON! It rises for me! AWOOOOO!
The whole pack is in me. Come!
You will be the story the pups are afraid of.
grito.chefe.mag: This is the spell I never dared to cast. Today I dare.
The orb is warm. The words are ready. Begin.
grito.chefe.bru: The whole pact, all at once. Whatever it costs.
The marks burn down to the bone. That is the sign. It is you.
Shadow, bill me later. Give me strength now.
grito.instinto.humano: Something is off here… if I pay attention, I will find it.
This silence is not natural. Better open my eyes for real.
grito.instinto.anao: The stone is whispering. Let me listen properly.
By my beard! There is metal under this ground, I can feel it in my teeth.
grito.instinto.elfo: The trees remember someone who passed this way. I will listen to them.
The wind smells different. The forest wants to show me something.
grito.instinto.gue: The smell of old blood. Someone fled this way.
My blood ran hot out of nowhere. There is a trail in this ground.
grito.instinto.pal: The Light weighs on my chest here. Some soul is calling for help.
Auréon, show me what the eyes cannot see.
grito.instinto.cac: Silver in the eyes. Something hidden here is not of this world.
The air tastes of sulphur. Time to hunt carefully.
grito.instinto.tec: The gauges twitched. There is a lost device around here.
Anomalous reading. I will calibrate and look again.
grito.instinto.vam: There is a heart beating where it should not. Listen…
The night told me a secret. Let me hear the rest.
grito.instinto.lob: That smell… the pack came through here. Sniff.
My fur is standing on end. The nose never lies.
grito.instinto.mag: The weave of the world is crooked here. Old magic, hidden.
The runes on my staff have grown warm. There is something to see.
grito.instinto.bru: The marks burn. Someone left a pact buried here.
The shadow whispered a name. I will listen with the other ear.
